title: pm-dispatch: teach the seat the PR body trailer door (issue_patch signed on its last line) where it rewrites a PR body
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① governed text left silent by a landed tool change. #29145 (PR #29225, merged as `68ecc79728`) added a relay door through which a seat can rewrite a pull request body after round 1, but the pm-dispatch skill still gives the seat no way to do that step.
Reader: `domain:skills`, for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md`. This is a governed Tier S/H surface, so it needs the lane's contract review.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "issue_patch trailer" → #29145 (the tool card, closed by PR #29225) and #27113 (the signature rule, closed). "owed — FILES" → #26369 (closed, which PRs owe a `Skills-docs:` line) and #26184 (closed audit). Neither teaches a door for rewriting a PR body.
reach: every seat that lands a PR whose body went stale after round 1, and every seat that rewrites `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — FILES` to `#N` before ACCEPT.
type: Bug

Business reason: a review that asks "update the body before landing" could not be met, so seats carried the correction in their seat records instead (PR #28920, #29014, #29083). The tool now has the door. Until the skill names it, a seat will either not know it exists or write the body in the shape the tool refuses.

## What the tool does now (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, header and `readPullRequestTargets`)
- An `issue_patch` carrying a `body` may be signed by its last non-empty line, `<!-- signed: LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION -->`, instead of a first-line signature. Line 1 stays the attribution comment or `Fixes #n`.
- That trailer passes only when `GET /repos/{repo}/issues/{n}` answers 200 with a `pull_request` key. An issue exits 2, and an unread target exits 3. A dry run judges the same way.
- Measured live on PR #29225's own body (relay run 41424245210): the platform keeps the trailer and appends no footer, and the read-back was identical.

## What the skill says today
- `SKILL.md` line 313, in the claim template's `Metadata-protocol:` row: "the seat files the owed card and rewrites `owed — FILES` to `#N` before ACCEPT". It names no door for that rewrite.
- `references/seat-post-protocol.md` line 30: 「帖与卡正文首行恒为署名 `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION`」. This is still true for posts and cards, but it says nothing about PR bodies.

## Wanted
- One line wherever the skill has the seat rewrite a PR body. It should say to send the whole body as `issue_patch` through `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, ending in the trailer on the last line, with no footer of the seat's own.
- One clause in `seat-post-protocol.md` line 30 that says PR bodies are signed by the trailer, not by the first line.
